fields.rationale: The projection is defined 'for each product and month', so the statistical unit is product x calendar month.

value.name: France product-monthly sales cells; unit key = (prod_id, calendar month)

fields.rationale: The projection formula divides by 2019 sales and needs the 2020 value, so both years and a non-zero baseline are required.
fields.value: Only product-month cells that have sales in BOTH 2019 and 2020 (growth rate needs both years); cells with a zero 2019 baseline are dropped (growth undefined). No zero-filling.

value: country = France (countries.country_name='France' via customers.country_id); calendar year in (2019, 2020) as baseline; promotions.promo_total_id = 1; channels.channel_total_id = 1

fields.rationale: Only these tables carry the needed attributes.

value.note: sales is the fact table; customer->country gives France; promotions/channels provide the promo_total_id/channel_total_id filters; currency provides the monthly USD rate.

fields.value: sales.time_id (year and month via times.calendar_year / times.calendar_month_number)

fields.rationale: Growth requires both observations; zero-filling would distort the ratio.
fields.value: Product-months missing in either 2019 or 2020 are not projected (inner join on product+month); missing months are not zero-filled.

fields.rationale: Dimension keys are surrogate PKs, so joins do not duplicate fact rows.
fields.value: sales->promotions (promo_id) and sales->channels (channel_id) and sales->customers->countries are many-to-one (no fan-out); currency joined on country+year+month is one-to-one. amount_sold stays additive at the product x month grain.

of.description: Projected 2021 monthly sales in USD per France product-month = (((sum(amount_sold,2020) - sum(amount_sold,2019)) / sum(amount_sold,2019)) * sum(amount_sold,2020)) + sum(amount_sold,2020), then x currency.to_us(France,2021,month); median is taken over the 12 monthly averages
Projected 2021 monthly sales in USD per France product-month (same projection formula), then each product's 12-month average; median taken over products
Projected 2021 monthly sales in USD per France product-month (same projection formula), summed over products per month; median over the 12 monthly country totals

fields.rationale: amount_sold is an additive measure summed per product-month.
fields.value: Sum of amount_sold across sales rows, aggregated to product x calendar-month x year; the median/avg operate on product-month projections.

fields.rationale: Average across products uses the count of projected products in the month.
fields.value: For the per-month average layer, the denominator is the number of products with a valid projection in that month; months with no products contribute nothing. Median layer has no denominator.

fields.rationale: Monthly averages are formed by month, then reduced to one value by median.
value: Inner grouping by calendar month (1-12); the final answer is a single scalar with no output grouping.

fields.rationale: The question asks for one median value in USD.
